limitations.description: Marketing content is produced by Meltwater, the vendor whose products are repeatedly promoted throughout the report, introducing potential commercial bias.
limitations.evidence: Brands that want to stay ahead … That’s where Meltwater makes the difference… Mira, Explore+, Klear, GenAI Lens

limitations.description: Key statistics draw on Meltwater’s proprietary “2026 Global Digital Overview”, but the underlying data sources or methodology are not disclosed, limiting reproducibility and independent verification.
limitations.evidence: The average consumer now uses nearly seven platforms per month, according to our 2026 Global Digital Overview

limitations.description: Many claims are forward-looking projections (e.g., technology adoption in 2026-2028) that are inherently uncertain and may not materialise.
limitations.evidence: According to Gartner, by 2028 AI-powered search will displace conventional web search as the primary discovery channel for consumers

limitations.description: External figures (e.g., Forbes, McKinsey) are cited anecdotally without full references or links, hindering readers’ ability to validate the numbers.
limitations.evidence: Research from Forbes shows that 24 percent of people already prefer to use social media platforms over Google for search queries
